title: No-Machine Blueberry Yogurt Ice Cream
excerpt: Make a creamy blueberry and yogurt ice cream at home without an ice cream machine. A fresh, smooth option full of the natural sweetness of our fruit.
imageAlt: Scoops of creamy blueberry yogurt ice cream served in a bowl with fresh blueberries on top
steps: In a small pot over medium heat, cook one and a half cups of Fresh Pick blueberries with the honey and lemon juice for 5 minutes, until they soften and release their juice.
Remove the mixture from the heat, lightly mash the fruit with a fork and let it cool to room temperature.
In a deep bowl, whip the very cold heavy cream with the vanilla extract until it forms soft peaks.
Add the Greek yogurt and fold it into the whipped cream with gentle, folding motions.
Pour the cold blueberry compote and the remaining half cup of whole blueberries over the cream, mixing gently to create a pretty marbled effect.
Transfer the mixture to a freezer-safe container, cover with a lid and freeze for at least 4 hours before enjoying.
tips: Our Fresh Pick blueberries are grown above 2,800 m above sea level in Guasca; their natural bloom and firmness make the whole berries add an incredible texture in every bite.
For the best texture when serving, take the ice cream out of the freezer about 10 minutes beforehand so you can scoop it easily.
